# Function to warp a list of images to match specified shapes using a reference frame and a transformation.

def warp_images(images, shapes, reference_frame, transform, prefix='', verbose=None):
    wrap = partial(print_progress, prefix='{}Warping images'.format(prefix), end_with_newline=not prefix, verbose=verbose)

    warped_images = []
    # Build a dummy transform, use set_target for efficiency
    warp_transform = transform(reference_frame.landmarks['source'].lms, reference_frame.landmarks['source'].lms)
    for i, s in wrap(list(zip(images, shapes))):
        # Update Transform Target
        warp_transform.set_target(s)
        # warp images
        warped_i = i.warp_to_mask(reference_frame.mask, warp_transform, warp_landmarks=False)
        # attach reference frame landmarks to images
        warped_i.landmarks['source'] = reference_frame.landmarks['source']
        warped_images.append(warped_i)
    return warped_images
